rca_of_issue: Root cause: payment_endpoints.py _lazy_free_session_used calls _supabase_get which uses urllib.request.urlopen with 15s timeout to query Supabase REST API. In the current container environment, the HTTPS connection to Supabase is timing out. This causes the /api/payments/eligibility endpoint to throw an exception -> SessionPaymentGate catches it as error -> shows PaywallModal to all users. The code logic is correct but the Supabase REST API URL is unreachable from this container via raw urllib.
